DESCRIPTION:Free Dental, Vision, and Medical Services
Note: Denture Services are not available at this clinic.
All services are free and offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Open to everyone. No ID required. No insurance required. No income requirements.
Dental: Cleanings, fillings, extractions
Vision: Eye exams and glasses
Medical: Basic health exams and screenings

Parking Lot & Arrival
The parking lot opens no later than 11:59 p.m. (midnight local time) on Friday, March 12. It stays open all night.
Clinic doors open at 6 a.m.
When patients enter the lot, volunteers will guide vehicles where to park and wait so everyone stays in order based on arrival time.
Each patient must be present to receive a service ticket.
Service tickets are distributed based on arrival time.
Patients must remain in the parking lot to keep their place in line.
If a patient leaves and returns, they will be placed at the end of the line and will receive a new service ticket.
This policy helps keep the line fair for everyone.
There is no indoor waiting area before doors open.
Everyone waits in the parking lot.
Parking lots do not have heated or cooled shelter.
Bathrooms will be available.

What to Bring

Water and snacks
All medicines patients take (continue taking medications as directed)
Weather-appropriate clothing
Blankets and insulated layers (coat, gloves, hat) if it is cold
Phone charger if needed


Important Notes
Dental and vision services are limited and may fill early.
Patients may choose between dental and vision services.
Medical services are offered to every patient.
Closing times may change based on clinic capacity.
Weather or volunteer availability may affect services.
Patients must stay on site to keep their place in line.
Please check this page for updates before traveling.
Visit the FAQ page ( https://www.ramusa.org/frequently-asked-questions/ ) for more general information about clinics.
For questions about this clinic, call 865-579-1530 Monday – Friday, 8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.
Details may change. Please check for updates before you travel.

SUMMARY:Hamblen County Central Services (Telehealth)
DESCRIPTION:Visit an online doctor via RAM’s Mobile Telehealth Unit with an on-site nurse to walk you through the process!
As patients arrive to the telehealth clinic, they will be provided with additional information regarding next steps.
Continue to check the RAM website (ramusa.org) and social media accounts for more opportunities to receive free care.
Free telehealth services are provided on a first-come, first-served basis. Medical services only. No Dental or Vision services will be offered. We will have assorted medical giveaways available for patients.
All services are free and open to the public. No ID required.
RAM Telehealth’s mobile services are provided on board Remote Area Medical’s Mobile Telehealth Unit. It is equipped with two exam rooms, where on-site nurses will walk patients through the process of seeing a doctor online. No technology or internet connection is required by the patient.
In some situations, such as inclement weather, volunteer cancellations, or other circumstances outside of RAM’s control, the mobile clinic may open later or a smaller number of patients served. RAM encourages everyone who would like services to arrive as early as possible.
*Clinic closing time may vary based on daily capacity. Please check RAM’s clinic FAQ page ( https://www.ramusa.org/telehealth/#TelehealthFAQ ) for more information.
**The above details are subject to change. Please continue to check our schedule regularly for updates as your clinic dates near.
